channels.name: micro plugin channel
channels.instructions: The ZIP is a micro colorscheme plugin named livingcode (micro identifiers cannot contain hyphens); its Lua loader registers all four existing native schemes. Create a v-prefixed release matching package.json and upload the ZIP at the URL in repo.json. Submit the reviewed registry metadata according to the channel's current process; the repo.json URL is prepared, not live. Existing direct theme downloads remain supported. No release, tag or upstream PR is created by packaging.
